Consider two containers \(A\) and \(B\) containing monoatomic gases at the same Pressure \((P)\), Volume \((V)\) and Temperature ( \(T\) ). \[

& P_1 V_1=P_2 V_2 \\

\]

questions.question:
If the coefficient of \(x^7\) in \(\left(a x-\frac{1}{b x^2}\right)^{13}\) and the coefficient of \(x^{-5}\) in \(\left(a x+\frac{1}{b x^2}\right)^{13}\) are equal, then \(a^4 b^4\) is equal to............

 

[JEE Main 2023, 10 Apr (Shift 1)]
questions.explanation:
In \(\left(ax-\dfrac{1}{bx^2}\right)^{13}\), the general term is \(\binom{13}{r}(ax)^{13-r}\left(-\dfrac{1}{bx^2}\right)^r\).

The power of \(x\) is \(13-r-2r=13-3r\).

For the term containing \(x^7\), \(13-3r=7\), so \(r=2\).

Its coefficient is \(\binom{13}{2}\dfrac{a^{11}}{b^2}\).

In \(\left(ax+\dfrac{1}{bx^2}\right)^{13}\), the power of \(x\) is also \(13-3r\).

For the term containing \(x^{-5}\), \(13-3r=-5\), so \(r=6\).

Its coefficient is \(\binom{13}{6}\dfrac{a^7}{b^6}\).

Equating the two coefficients gives \(\binom{13}{2}\dfrac{a^{11}}{b^2}=\binom{13}{6}\dfrac{a^7}{b^6}\).

Therefore, \(a^4b^4=\dfrac{\binom{13}{6}}{\binom{13}{2}}\).

Now \(\binom{13}{6}=1716\) and \(\binom{13}{2}=78\).

Hence \(a^4b^4=\dfrac{1716}{78}=22\).
